description: Microsoft Jackpot captures the full experience of modern video slots with uniquely-themed slot machines, awesome bonus games and features, and huge jackpots! Beautiful Graphics and Sound Adventure through the jungle in search of a secret temple where great riches await, explore the depths of the ocean to hunt down a sunken treasure, track down an international jewel thief in a high stakes card game.
